requestTitle: Stratospheric water vapor and temperature variability in WACCM and satellite observations

opportunityQA.attributeSetName: Data Analysis projects require that you intend to use an NCAR-curated data set in the analysis. Which NCAR-curated data sets will you be using as part of your data analysis activities?
opportunityQA.attributeName: Briefly describe your planned use of NCAR data sets.
opportunityQA.attributeValue: This project will use the Gridded cold-point tropopause temperature records from CDAAC Merged Radio Occultation Data. In addition, we will analyze Specified Dynamics WACCM (SD-WACCM) simulations archived on NCAR Derecho, including temperature and water vapor fields.
opportunityQA.answer: This project will use the Gridded cold-point tropopause temperature records from CDAAC Merged Radio Occultation Data. In addition, we will analyze Specified Dynamics WACCM (SD-WACCM) simulations archived on NCAR Derecho, including temperature and water vapor fields.
